verdict.rationale: Version control over skill updates is a fair question for a skills plugin. There is indirect evidence of some control: a hands-on probe shows `npx skills add ... --copy` vendors plain SKILL.md folders into the project's ./.claude/skills/ directory, where a team can commit them as a fixed snapshot. The README also says updating on Antigravity means reinstalling with the same command, which implies updates are manual rather than silent. Nothing documents version pinning, tagged-release selection or a lockfile, so this control comes only from a vendoring workaround. Missing for 10: documented version pinning or install-by-tag, a lockfile, explicit no-auto-update guarantees for marketplace/plugin installs, and team-level update governance docs.
